description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT against the app's tables (its own schema). Returns { columns, rows (arrays), truncated }: at most 1000 rows and 10 MB; int8/numeric come back as strings, bytea as base64, dates as ISO text. Writes, multiple statements and system functions are refused.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

params.description: Values for $1, $2 … (strings, numbers, booleans, null, or JSON for json/jsonb columns).

sql.description: Exactly one SQL statement. Use $1, $2 … for values.

name: query
